name: Jio Financial Services Limited
summary: Jio Financial Services Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the business of investing and financing, insurance broking, payment bank and payment aggregator, and payment gateway services in India. The company provides loans, savings accounts, recharges, fixed deposits, digital insurance, financial tracking, management tools, digital banking, UPI bill payments, and insurance advisory; and asset and wealth management, and broking services, as well as supply chain and vendor financing and enterprise leasing solutions for devices and cars to corporates, gold, and leasing solutions to individuals and businesses.
